title: Closed-immersion ideal annihilates scalar Ext
statement: For a closed immersion $i:Z\to Y$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $J$ be its ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. In any derived category [def-pc-derived-category], let $F=H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], for any integer $q$. The multiplication $J\otimes F\to F$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is zero. No regularity assumption is required.

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution of O_Y, hence a K-injective complex. Compute derived internal Hom from the degree-zero pushforward by the Hom complex.

Construct the sheaf-algebra Hom complex over the pushed-forward structure algebra. Its restriction of scalars is the above Hom complex. Restriction of scalars preserves finite limits and colimits, hence commutes with homology.
An ideal section maps to zero under i.app: factor i through its scheme-theoretic image and use mem_idealOfOpens_iff. Thus it acts as zero on every section of the restricted homology algebra module.

Use the tensor sheafification universal property and tensor induction to turn sectionwise annihilation into zero multiplication. Transport this equation across the homology isomorphism using the left unitor and whisker exchange naturality.

theorem closedImmersion_ext_idealAction_eq_zero
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (q : ℤ) :
    let F : Y.Modules := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
    i.ker.toModulesι ▷ F ≫ (λ_ F).hom = 0
